policies.purpose: development alert optimization; no new independent final test
policies.selection: minimum validation alerts at recall target; tie: fewer FP, higher AP, candidate order
policies.threshold: highest score threshold achieving min recall on validation only; ties stay together
policies.history: [approval - 90 days, approval), using completed eligible deliveries only
policies.history_update: known delivery outcomes update features as time passes, including within validation/evaluation
policies.history_prior: global rate fixed prior .05 with strength20; seller/route rates shrink to current global rate
policies.preprocessing: fit only on each maturity-purged train; numeric history columns are included in pipeline
policies.original_holdout: already inspected; final-period scores are retrospective diagnostics only, never model/threshold selection
policies.promotion: save separate balanced artifact; original artifact and original reports remain intact
policies.recall_guarantee: validation target is not a guarantee for later evaluation or live orders

f1.objective: maximize validation F1 over unique validation prediction scores
f1.tie_break: highest threshold among equal F1 values (numerical tolerance 1e-12)

balanced.objective: minimize validation alert count subject to recall >= min_recall
balanced.tie_policy: highest feasible observed threshold; all equal scores receive the same prediction
balanced.evaluation_note: Validation recall does not guarantee recall on evaluation or future orders
